verdict.summary: The complete two-file diff was inspected against issue #426 and trusted policy. Workflow provenance is strengthened, but it is not bound to the exact pull request version being gated.

blockingFindings.title: Bind workflow evidence to the pull request being gated
blockingFindings.details: At head 95174f47e7913c8ed3f00a263bed2f45f5d58dfd, checksFor passes only the commit SHA into provenance validation. For pull-request events, hasTrustedWorkflowProvenance accepts any associated PR whose head has that SHA and whose base is main or dev; it never verifies the current PR number, expected base ref, or expected base SHA. workflow_dispatch evidence has no PR association at all. Consequently, a successful Validate or DarkFactory Autoreview run for another PR sharing the same head commit can authorize a release or reconciliation PR with a different base and therefore a different diff. The reconciliation tests conceal this gap by supplying base-main workflow evidence while gating PRs targeting dev. Pass the exact pull-request identity/version through checksFor and require matching PR number, base ref, base SHA, head ref, and head SHA; add a regression proving same-head evidence from another PR/base is rejected.

nonBlockingNotes: The inventory code covers bounded pagination, declared totals, duplicate IDs, malformed evidence, and two-pass mutation detection.
Execution results are correctly left to the independent exact-head Validate gate.
